problems.reason: The page gives conflicting age ranges for Micropachycephalosaurus: sentence 11 cites ~77 Ma (Late Cretaceous), sentence 12 places it in the Campanian stage (~83–72 Ma), and sentence 14 lists a broader range of 89.8–83.6 Ma (Coniacian to Santonian).
